craft_notes: Sthāyin: six grades chanted. Rows: grades roll. Read aloud: six-beat count.

lines: Common, common-common, common-rare, rare-common, rare, rarest-rare —
sixfold the feast, born of the rite's fulfillment.
l4.sanskrit_cite: tatra sāmānyaṃ sāmānyasāmānyaṃ sāmānyaviśeṣo viśeṣasāmānyaṃ viśeṣo viśeṣaviśeṣaś ca iti ṣoḍhā parva
